name: NativeActivity spatial evidence shell
definition: Android lifecycle delegates to a C++20 evidence engine.

name: POCO arm64 product flavor
definition: A named arm64-only flavor targets owner-device deployment.

name: Universal Android fallback
definition: A multi-ABI flavor preserves portable testing.

name: Camera runtime permission gate
definition: Camera startup is blocked until Android permission is granted.

name: Rear-camera capability selection
definition: The NDK camera selector chooses a rear YUV stream nearest the requested size.

name: YUV luma-only acquisition
definition: The default pipeline copies only the measured Y plane.

name: Latest-frame bounded buffer
definition: Camera callback replacement prevents unbounded frame queues.

name: Capture calibration descriptor hash
definition: Camera ID, stream, focal and sensor metadata produce a session hash.

name: NDK accelerometer intake
definition: Latest acceleration is timestamped with frame observations.

name: NDK gyroscope intake
definition: Latest angular velocity is timestamped with frame observations.

name: NDK rotation-vector intake
definition: Orientation quaternion is normalized before storage.

name: Seeded analysis tie-breaking
definition: SplitMix64 deterministically resolves sparse candidate ordering.

name: Fixed 160x90 analysis surface
definition: A bounded low-resolution luma field drives extraction and display.

name: Grid-distributed feature budget
definition: Candidates are distributed across spatial cells before global trimming.

name: Gradient evidence floor
definition: Low-texture candidates are excluded before proposal creation.

name: Luma signature keyframe gate
definition: A 64-bit block signature detects visual change.

name: Orientation keyframe gate
definition: Quaternion angle change can promote a keyframe.

name: Minimum keyframe interval
definition: Fast duplicates are rejected to bound storage.

name: Maximum keyframe interval
definition: Long gaps force periodic evidence capture.

name: Exact voxel key 64-bit profile
definition: Level4 and signed XYZ20 fields pack into one key.

name: Exact ray key 64-bit profile
definition: Log-depth20, azimuth18, elevation14 and time12 form a ray key.

name: Stable seeded identifier namespaces
definition: Session seed, namespace and address form repeatable stable IDs.

name: Typed native event proposal
definition: Kind, confidence, error, uncertainty, metrics and tags are explicit.

name: Ordered support gate
definition: A proposal outside declared support is rejected.

name: Ordered compatibility gate
definition: Semantic/topological incompatibility is reason coded.

name: Ordered guard gate
definition: Only allowed guard classes continue to commit.

name: Ordered confidence gate
definition: Non-finite or low-confidence candidates are rejected.

name: Ordered numeric-error gate
definition: Event error must remain under policy margin.

name: Ordered uncertainty gate
definition: Unbounded or excessive uncertainty is rejected.

name: Metric availability gate
definition: Metric-required events fail when no metric source is ready.

name: Single ledger mutation boundary
definition: Only verified commit applies authoritative state changes.

name: Event pre-state hash
definition: Every event records the previous canonical state digest.

name: Event post-state hash
definition: Every accepted event produces the next canonical state digest.

name: Stable map-node evidence accumulation
definition: Evidence updates stable identity without coordinate-only merging.

name: Stable route-node record
definition: Route positions and uncertainty remain distinct from identifiers.

name: Stable route-edge record
definition: Passability, clearance, slope and confidence are typed.

name: Seed-generated deterministic route fixture
definition: Offline testing reconstructs a fixed route graph from one seed.

name: Synthetic evidence tag
definition: Fallback/demo proposals carry a dedicated high tag bit.

name: KSEED fixed session header
definition: Capture/storage policy is declared in a 128-byte header.

name: KSEED fixed chunk header
definition: Sequence, sizes, CRCs and chain hash use a 64-byte header.

name: Frame timestamp delta encoding
definition: Keyframe time is stored relative to the previous retained frame.

name: Frame index delta encoding
definition: Frame indices use unsigned varint deltas.

name: Quantized inertial summaries
definition: Quaternion, acceleration and gyro values use bounded int16 fields.

name: Morton feature ordering
definition: 2D feature addresses are sorted for small deltas.

name: Varint feature deltas
definition: Morton, score and record lengths use base-128 varints.

name: Conditional zlib chunk compression
definition: Compression is accepted only when it beats raw payload plus margin.

name: Header CRC32
definition: The session header has an independent integrity check.

name: Stored-payload CRC32
definition: Compressed/transmitted bytes are checked before decode.

name: Decoded-payload CRC32
definition: The reconstructed raw chunk is checked after decompression.

name: SHA-256 chunk chain
definition: Each chunk authenticates order and predecessor bytes at file level.

name: Exact summary byte count
definition: The final summary predicts and records complete file size.

name: App-private session storage
definition: Native files are written under package-private files/sessions.

name: No raw-frame default
definition: POCO seed profile disables raw image retention.

name: No network permission default
definition: The package has no declared internet permission.

name: Bayer 8x8 display projection
definition: Ordered dither presents luma and state with one R8 texture.

name: Renderer non-authority rule
definition: Display output cannot mutate ledger state.

name: High-refresh presentation request
definition: ANativeWindow frame-rate request targets 120 Hz when supported.

name: Thermal feature-budget reduction
definition: Thermal tiers reduce frame rate and feature count.

name: Thermal capture pause
definition: Severe status pauses authoritative capture instead of producing degraded claims.

name: Codex owner-device handoff
definition: Build, install, log, pull and validation scripts define the deployment gate.
